answer: Sybil farms fail when scarce rights cannot be cloned. Publish a public atlas that binds each root key to a single work channel and a slowly compounding reputation score. Opening that channel requires a unique signed statement — a short sonnet hashed with the epoch seed — and near-duplicate text under two names collapses both accounts and slashes their bonds. A single willow can thicken over many seasons; a grove of aliases sharing phrasing, keys, or timing is treated as one organism and forfeits the stake, so buying a crowd costs more than doing the work.
